rome.name: Rome
rome.description: The city on the Tiber that became the center of Roman political and military power.

palatine-hill.name: Palatine Hill
palatine-hill.description: One of Rome’s central hills, associated in Roman tradition with the city’s foundation.

alba-longa.name: Alba Longa
alba-longa.description: A legendary Latin city southeast of Rome, traditionally linked to Rome’s founding story. Its exact location is uncertain.

lavinium.name: Lavinium
lavinium.description: An ancient Latin settlement near the coast, associated in Roman tradition with Aeneas.

ostia.name: Ostia
ostia.description: Rome’s ancient port at the mouth of the Tiber.

circus-maximus.name: Circus Maximus
circus-maximus.description: Rome’s major chariot-racing venue, in the valley between the Palatine and Aventine hills.

forum-romanum.name: Forum Romanum
forum-romanum.description: The civic and ceremonial center of ancient Rome.

etruria.name: Etruria
etruria.description: The region of central Italy associated with the Etruscan civilization.

universe.name: Universe
universe.description: The totality of space, time, matter, and energy.

solar-system.name: Solar System
solar-system.description: The Sun and the celestial bodies bound to it by gravity.

earth.name: Earth
earth.description: The planet where life and human history developed.

africa.name: Africa
africa.description: The continent where the earliest known hominins and Homo sapiens evolved.

eurasia.name: Eurasia
eurasia.description: The connected landmass of Europe and Asia.

oceania.name: Oceania
oceania.description: The Pacific region that includes Australia and the islands of the Pacific.

americas.name: Americas
americas.description: The continents of North and South America.

north-america.name: North America
north-america.description: The northern continent of the Americas.

mesopotamia.name: Mesopotamia
mesopotamia.description: The historical region between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers.

egypt.name: Egypt
egypt.description: A country in northeast Africa, shaped by the Nile and its delta.

greece.name: Greece
greece.description: The southeastern European region where ancient Greek communities developed.

tunisia.name: Tunisia
tunisia.description: The North African country that contains the ancient site of Carthage.

india.name: India
india.description: A country in South Asia, home to some of the earliest human settlements outside Africa.

italy.name: Italy
italy.description: The Mediterranean peninsula that became the core of Roman expansion.

latium.name: Latium
latium.description: The region of central Italy inhabited by Latin communities, including Rome.

tiber-river.name: Tiber River
tiber-river.description: The river running through Rome and connecting the city with the Tyrrhenian coast.

quirinal-hill.name: Quirinal Hill
quirinal-hill.description: The northernmost of Rome’s traditional seven hills, associated in legend with the Sabines.

carthage.name: Carthage
carthage.description: The Phoenician-founded city in North Africa that became Rome’s principal rival in the western Mediterranean.
